channel.title: Trulinq guides
channel.description: Plain, sourced guides to checking businesses, websites, profiles and invoices before you trust them with your money, your data or your name.

item.title: What is KYC? Identity and business checks, explained
item.description: What KYC and KYB mean, the rules behind them, how ID and selfie checks really work, what businesses are asked for, and how your data should be protected.

item.title: How to tell if a website is legit
item.description: How to check a website before you buy, sign in or type a card number: read the real domain, check its age, test the padlock myth and pay the safe way.

item.title: How to spot a fake LinkedIn profile
item.description: The checks that still catch fake LinkedIn profiles, recruiters and investors, now that AI faces look real: verification badges, history, photos and asks.

item.title: How to find out who owns a business
item.description: Where ownership is actually on record: state filings, DBA records, SEC filings, Form 990s, and the Canadian and UK registers of people with control.

item.title: How to check if a business is legit
item.description: Twelve checks that tell a real company from a convincing front: official registries, licenses, addresses, reviews, court records and how to pay safely.

item.title: Business email compromise: how to stop fake invoices
item.description: How business email compromise and fake invoice scams work, the controls that stop them, and what to do in the first hours if money has already gone.
